engine: A variation of the day↔night canon (window.DayNight). It drives the canon's cursor driver + seam reveal — a vertical clip-path inset that follows the cursor via gsap.quickTo — and dresses it in the Smarts chrome: the round ⇆ grip on the seam line, День/Вечір corner tags, and a curtain hint that fades after the first move. Cursor at left = day; cursor at right = evening, wiping in from the right of the seam.
entry: DayNightCursorSeam.create(target, { dayMedia, nightMedia, hint, ease?, rest?, labels? }) -> { root, dn, set(t), get(), hideHint(), resetHint(), destroy }. set(t) is PURE (0=day .. 1=evening), forwarded from the canon. The canon is driven with mode:'cursor', reveal:'seam'.

seed.move: const sp={v:55}; main.style.setProperty('--split', sp.v+'%'); vTo=gsap.quickTo(sp,'v',{duration:0.5,ease:'power3.out'}); moveSplit(clientX)=vTo(clamp(6,94,((clientX-left)/width)*100)); mousemove/touchmove->moveSplit; mouseleave->vTo(55). .night clip-path: inset(0 0 0 var(--split)); hint fades after first move.

mapping.split_55pct: canon rest:0.45 — cursor at left=day(0), at right=evening(1); rest 0.45 sits the seam a touch past centre, matching Smarts' 55% resting split feel.
mapping.clamp_6_94: canon clamps t to 0.06..0.94 (cursor section of tokens) — same edges as Smarts' Math.max(6,Math.min(94,...)).
mapping.quickTo_0.5_power3.out: canon ease:0.5 -> its internal gsap.quickTo duration 0.5 ease power3.out, identical to the seed.
mapping.splitline_grip: the canon paints .dn__seamline + ::after (round 44px ⇆, #f3f1ec, drop shadow) — V3 only polishes hover/touch scale.
